census_caveat: Every census entry is a regex probe over oracle text. A probe that matched 0 cards proves nothing: no-match is not the same as does-not-exist. Only positive matches, with the oracle text they matched, are facts. Never treat a 0-match line as a hard constraint on what a deck can do — verify against the actual oracle text in your pool before relying on it.
pool_limits: Ritual probe (a nonland 'Add ...' clause producing more mana than the card's cost, non-repeatable) matched 0 cards. No-match is not does-not-exist: this probe cannot see untap-lands effects, mana multipliers, cost reducers, or free spells, which can accelerate mana just as well. Check the pool's oracle text before treating acceleration as unavailable.

5 lands are Lairs (Crosis's Catacombs, Darigaaz's Caldera, Dromar's Cavern, Rith's Grove, Treva's Ruins): each returns a land you control to your hand, so it swaps a land rather than adding one and does not raise your battlefield land count.
The cube list contains no basic lands. Basics are format-supplied and exempt from copy limits; every nonbasic land in the pool is listed under lands_by_identity.
chains_caveat: interaction_chains is an authored, known-incomplete list. Absence of a chain is not absence of an engine — the cube may contain engines no chain records. Derive card compositions from oracle text first; use chains as recorded evidence of engines that exist, never as the boundary of what exists.

interaction_chains.mechanism: Dralnu's Crusade: 'All Goblins are black and are Zombies in addition to their other creature types.' Deadapult: '{R}, Sacrifice a Zombie: This enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.' With Dralnu's Crusade on the battlefield, every Goblin is a Zombie and is therefore a legal sacrifice for Deadapult. Skirk Prospector: 'Sacrifice a Goblin: Add {R}' produces the {R} that a Deadapult activation costs.

Pashalik Mons: 'Whenever Pashalik Mons or another Goblin you control dies, Pashalik Mons deals 1 damage to any target.' Skirk Prospector ('Sacrifice a Goblin: Add {R}') is a mono-red sacrifice outlet whose activation cost contains no mana, so it converts a Goblin into a Pashalik Mons trigger at no mana cost. Mogg War Marshal: 'When this creature enters or dies, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token' supplies bodies on both entry and death. Goblin Turncoat ('Sacrifice a Goblin: Regenerate this creature') is an optional off-colour (black) second outlet, not required to execute the core.

Siege-Gang Commander: 'When this creature enters, create three 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens. {1}{R}, Sacrifice a Goblin: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.' The ability targets any target, so Goblins convert into damage aimed at a player. Skirk Prospector's 'Sacrifice a Goblin: Add {R}' can supply part of the {1}{R} activation cost.

Gempalm Incinerator: 'Cycling {1}{R}' and 'When you cycle this card, you may have it deal X damage to target creature, where X is the number of Goblins on the battlefield.' X counts Goblins on the battlefield, including Goblin tokens and Goblins an opponent controls. Cycling is an activated ability, not a cast, so it does not add to a storm count.

Goblin Matron: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Goblin card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.' It fetches any card whose type line contains Goblin. Dralnu's Crusade is an Enchantment, not a Goblin card, and Empty the Warrens is a Sorcery, so neither is a legal target.

Fireblast: 'You may sacrifice two Mountains rather than pay this spell's mana cost.' The cost requires the Mountain land type, not basic Mountains. Geothermal Bog ('Land - Swamp Mountain'), Molten Tributary ('Land - Island Mountain'), Sacred Peaks ('Land - Mountain Plains') and Wooded Ridgeline ('Land - Mountain Forest') all carry the Mountain type and are therefore legal sacrifices.
requires: two lands with the Mountain type

interaction_chains.mechanism: High Tide: 'Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.' Frantic Search: 'Draw two cards, then discard two cards. Untap up to three lands.' Snap: 'Return target creature to its owner's hand. Untap up to two lands.' Cloud of Faeries: 'When this creature enters, untap up to two lands.' Peregrine Drake: 'When this creature enters, untap up to five lands.' Turnabout: 'untap all tapped permanents of that type target player controls' (choosing land, targeting yourself). With High Tide resolved, every Island tapped that turn produces 2 mana, so a spell that untaps Islands can add more mana than it cost to cast. Each spell cast this way also raises the count for Storm ('When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn' - Grapeshot, Empty the Warrens) and the X of Stroke of Genius ('Target player draws X cards').
requires: lands with the Island subtype: basic Islands are format-supplied; in the cube list only Tangled Islet, Molten Tributary, Contaminated Aquifer and Idyllic Beachfront have the Island subtype

interaction_chains.mechanism: Helm of Awakening: 'Spells cost {1} less to cast.' Nightscape Familiar: 'Blue spells and red spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.' Storm ('When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn') counts casts, not mana spent, so reducing each spell's cost by {1} raises the number of spells castable from the same mana in one turn.
requires: the reducer on the battlefield before the storm turn's casts

interaction_chains.mechanism: Wild Growth: 'Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional {G}.' Krosan Restorer: '{T}: Untap target land' and with threshold '{T}: Untap up to three target lands.' Untapping the enchanted land lets it be tapped again the same turn, adding the extra {G} on each tap. Gauntlet of Power: 'Whenever a basic land is tapped for mana of the chosen color, its controller adds an additional one mana of that color' - basic lands are format-supplied even though the cube list contains none.
requires: threshold (seven or more cards in your graveyard) for Krosan Restorer's multi-land mode

interaction_chains.mechanism: Frantic Search: 'Draw two cards, then discard two cards.' Vexing Sphinx: 'Cumulative upkeep-Discard a card.' Body Snatcher: 'When this creature enters, exile it unless you discard a creature card.' Each puts creature cards into the graveyard at low mana cost. Life // Death (Death half): 'Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You lose life equal to its mana value' for {1}{B}. Dread Return: 'Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield' with 'Flashback-Sacrifice three creatures.' Chainer, Dementia Master: '{B}{B}{B}, Pay 3 life: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.' Body Snatcher: 'When this creature dies, exile it and return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.' The discard half converts a creature too expensive to cast into a battlefield presence at reanimation cost instead of mana cost.
requires: a creature card in the graveyard before the reanimation spell resolves

interaction_chains.mechanism: Empty the Warrens: 'Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens' plus Storm copies. Battle Screech: 'Create two 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying' with 'Flashback-Tap three untapped white creatures you control.' Mogg War Marshal: enters with an additional Goblin token. Dread Return: 'Flashback-Sacrifice three creatures.' Token producers supply the three bodies that Dread Return's flashback sacrifices and the three white creatures Battle Screech's own flashback taps.
requires: three expendable creatures on the battlefield when the flashback cost is paid

interaction_chains.mechanism: Sneak Attack: '{R}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Sacrifice the creature at the beginning of the next end step.' The end-step sacrifice is a die trigger for cards that convert death into value: Body Snatcher 'When this creature dies, exile it and return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield'; Gamekeeper 'When this creature dies, you may exile it. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield.' A creature put into play with Sneak Attack attacks the same turn and its death cost is converted into another body.

Urza, Lord High Artificer: 'Tap an untapped artifact you control: Add {U}.' Every artifact, including ones with no mana ability of their own such as Helm of Awakening ('Spells cost {1} less to cast'), becomes a mana source while doing its printed job. Urza's entry token: 'create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."' - the same artifact count sets the token's size.

Yawgmoth, Thran Physician: 'Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature and draw a card.' The activation costs no mana, so every expendable creature converts into a card plus a -1/-1 counter. Token producers (Empty the Warrens: 'Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens' plus Storm; Battle Screech: 'Create two 1/1 white Bird creature tokens'; Mogg War Marshal's Goblin tokens) supply the sacrifices.

Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.' Frantic Search ('Draw two cards') and Deep Analysis ('Target player draws two cards', with Flashback) reach the second draw in one spell; Cloud of Faeries' 'Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)' and Yawgmoth's 'Sacrifice another creature: ... draw a card' add draws at instant speed. The trigger is once each turn, including opponents' turns, so instant-speed draw doubles the Cat output.
requires: a second card drawn in a turn

interaction_chains.mechanism: Cryptic Gateway: 'Tap two untapped creatures you control: You may put a creature card from your hand that shares a creature type with each creature tapped this way onto the battlefield.' Any tribe with enough members lets two small bodies deploy a large one at zero mana; dossier.tribal_rosters lists which creature types have the density to tap two and cast one reliably.
requires: two untapped creatures sharing a type with the card in hand

interaction_chains.mechanism: Horseshoe Crab: '{U}: Untap this creature.' Hermetic Study: 'Enchanted creature has "{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target."' With the Study on the Crab, each {U} spent untaps it for another activation, so every available blue mana converts to 1 damage. Quicksilver Dagger ('Enchanted creature has "{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker. You draw a card."') is an alternative aura that also draws a card per activation; it requires red as well and does not change the core identity.
requires: the aura attached to Horseshoe Crab or another creature with a repeatable untap

interaction_chains.mechanism: Opposition: 'Tap an untapped creature you control: Tap target artifact, creature, or land.' Horseshoe Crab: '{U}: Untap this creature' lets one creature tap repeatedly for mana spent. Token producers - Empty the Warrens: 'Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens' per storm copy; Battle Screech: 'Create two 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying' - supply many bodies, each of which taps one opposing permanent per turn cycle. The optional producers do not change the core identity.

High Tide: 'Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.' Time Stretch: 'Target player takes two extra turns after this one.' With High Tide active, each Island yields two mana, so the ten-mana extra-turn spell is castable from far fewer lands.

Lightning Rift: 'Whenever a player cycles a card, you may pay {1}. If you do, this enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.' Every card with a cycling cost - creatures, spells, and the cycling lands - triggers it, including cycles by the opponent.

Invigorating Boon: 'Whenever a player cycles a card, you may put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.' The same cycling casts that trigger Lightning Rift place counters, including cycles by the opponent.

Floodgate: 'When this creature leaves the battlefield, it deals damage to each nonblue creature without flying equal to half the number of Islands you control, rounded down.' Snap: 'Return target creature to its owner's hand. Untap up to two lands' - or Man-o'-War's enter trigger - can return our own Floodgate, converting the leave trigger into an Island-count sweeper on demand.

Obsessive Search and Circular Logic carry 'Madness {U}/{2}{U} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)' Frantic Search: 'Draw two cards, then discard two cards'; Aquamoeba: 'Discard a card:'; Zombie Infestation: 'Discard two cards:'; Jalum Tome: 'Draw a card, then discard a card'; Vexing Sphinx: 'Cumulative upkeep-Discard a card.' Each discard from any of these outlets converts a madness card into an additional cast. The black and red outlets are alternatives and do not change the core identity.
requires: a madness card in hand at the time of the discard

interaction_chains.mechanism: Empty the Warrens: 'Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens' per storm copy; Mogg War Marshal: 'When this creature enters or dies, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.' Skirk Prospector: 'Sacrifice a Goblin: Add {R}.' Every Goblin token is therefore a stored {R}, convertible at instant speed.

Storm Entity: 'Haste / This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other spell cast this turn.' It consumes the same per-turn spell count that storm cards copy from: any sequence of cheap spells cast before it sizes it, and haste cashes the size immediately.
requires: spells cast earlier in the same turn

interaction_chains.mechanism: Grim Lavamancer: '{R}, {T}, Exile two cards from your graveyard: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.' Cheap instants and sorceries put themselves in the graveyard when they resolve; Frantic Search's 'discard two cards' and Fact or Fiction's 'the other [pile] into your graveyard' fill it faster. Every two graveyard cards are an activation.

Sneak Attack: '{R}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Sacrifice the creature at the beginning of the next end step.' Worldgorger Dragon: 'When this creature enters, exile all other permanents you control. / When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled cards to the battlefield under their owners' control.' Sneaking the Dragon exiles all other permanents including tapped lands; when the Dragon is sacrificed at end step, everything returns untapped.

Overmaster: 'The next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn can't be countered. Draw a card.' Grapeshot: 'Grapeshot deals 1 damage to any target.' with 'Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn...)'. Stroke of Genius: 'Target player draws X cards.' Casting Overmaster earlier in the turn makes the next instant or sorcery — Grapeshot or, as an optional alternative target, Stroke of Genius — impossible to counter.
requires: Overmaster cast in the same turn, immediately before the protected spell

interaction_chains.mechanism: Coal Stoker: 'When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, add {R}{R}{R}.' Snap: 'Return target creature to its owner's hand. Untap up to two lands.' Snap can return Coal Stoker to its owner's hand; recasting it from hand re-triggers the mana clause, and every Snap and recast adds to the turn's spell count.
requires: Coal Stoker cast from the hand each iteration

interaction_chains.mechanism: Frantic Search: 'Draw two cards, then discard two cards. Untap up to three lands.' Deep Analysis: 'Target player draws two cards.' with 'Flashback—{1}{U}, Pay 3 life.' Discarding Deep Analysis to Frantic Search puts it in the graveyard, where its flashback clause makes it castable.

High Tide: 'Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.' Arcanis the Omnipotent: '{T}: Draw three cards.' and '{2}{U}{U}: Return Arcanis to its owner's hand.' Doubled Island mana pays both the cast and the self-return activation.
requires: Arcanis the Omnipotent on the battlefield

interaction_chains.mechanism: Goblin Medics: 'Whenever this creature becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to any target.' Cryptic Gateway: 'Tap two untapped creatures you control: You may put a creature card from your hand that shares a creature type with each creature tapped this way onto the battlefield.' Tapping Goblin Medics as one of the two creatures for Cryptic Gateway's cost makes Goblin Medics become tapped, triggering its 'deals 1 damage to any target.' Both are Goblins, so the shared-type requirement is met and a Goblin card from hand can be put onto the battlefield.

Millikin: '{T}, Mill a card: Add {C}.' Slippery Karst / Drifting Meadow / Remote Isle: 'Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)' each place a card into the graveyard. Frantic Search: 'Draw two cards, then discard two cards. Untap up to three lands.' is an optional blue accelerant that bins two more. These feed the payoffs keyed to a full graveyard: Mystic Enforcer: 'Threshold - As long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +3/+3 and has flying.' Werebear: 'Threshold - This creature gets +3/+3 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.' Mystic Zealot and Vigilant Sentry carry the same 'seven or more cards in your graveyard' clause; Nantuko Monastery: 'Threshold - {G}{W}: This land becomes a 4/4 ... Activate only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.'; Divine Sacrament: 'Threshold - White creatures get an additional +1/+1 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.'
requires: seven or more cards in your graveyard

interaction_chains.mechanism: Terravore: 'Trample. Terravore's power and toughness are each equal to the number of land cards in all graveyards.' Slippery Karst / Drifting Meadow: 'Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)' send the land itself to the graveyard when cycled; Terminal Moraine: '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card ...' puts a land into the graveyard. Each land so binned raises Terravore's power and toughness.

Hunting Grounds: 'Threshold - As long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, this enchantment has "Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield."' Millikin and the cycling lands fill the graveyard to reach threshold; because the creature is put onto the battlefield rather than cast, its mana cost is never paid, so high-cost creatures such as Serra Avatar ('{4}{W}{W}{W}'), Phantom Nishoba ('{5}{G}{W}') and Serra Angel are deployed for free from hand.
requires: seven or more cards in your graveyard

interaction_chains.mechanism: Lyra Dawnbringer: 'Other Angels you control get +1/+1 and have lifelink.' Serra Angel: 'Creature - Angel' is an Angel, so it becomes a 5/5 flying vigilance with lifelink while Lyra is on the battlefield.

Gamekeeper: 'When this creature dies, you may exile it. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.' A single death both mills the revealed noncreature cards into the graveyard and puts a creature onto the battlefield without paying its cost.

Squirrel Nest: 'Enchant land / Enchanted land has "{T}: Create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token."' Nut Collector: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you may create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.' and 'Threshold - All Squirrels get +2/+2 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.' Both produce 1/1 green Squirrel tokens of the same type, and Nut Collector's threshold buffs every Squirrel on the battlefield, including those made by Squirrel Nest.
requires: a land to enchant with Squirrel Nest

interaction_chains.mechanism: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa: '{2}{G}{G}{G}: Creatures you control get +3/+3 and gain trample until end of turn.' Saproling Symbiosis: 'Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token for each creature you control.' Battle Screech and Call of the Herd create additional creature tokens. The token-makers build a wide board that Kamahl's activation pumps and grants trample in one turn.
requires: a board of creatures for Kamahl to pump

interaction_chains.mechanism: Radha, Heir to Keld: 'Whenever Radha attacks, you may add {R}{R}.' Siege-Gang Commander: '{1}{R}, Sacrifice a Goblin: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.' Pashalik Mons: '{3}{R}, Sacrifice a Goblin: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.' Radha's attack trigger adds the red mana that pays these repeated Goblin-sacrifice activations; Skirk Prospector ('Sacrifice a Goblin: Add {R}') is an alternative red source for the same activations.
requires: Radha attacking, or another red source

interaction_chains.mechanism: Kavu Primarch: 'Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)' Goblin Medics: 'Whenever this creature becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to any target.' Tapping Goblin Medics to convoke Kavu Primarch (or any convoke spell) causes it to become tapped, triggering its one damage.

Zombie Infestation: 'Discard two cards: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.' Necrosavant: '{3}{B}{B}, Sacrifice a creature: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only during your upkeep.' The Zombie tokens are creatures that can be sacrificed to Necrosavant's activation cost, so the discard outlet supplies the fodder to return Necrosavant from the graveyard each upkeep.

Zombie Infestation: 'Discard two cards: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.' Dread Return: 'Flashback—Sacrifice three creatures.' The tokens created by Zombie Infestation are three creatures that can be sacrificed to pay Dread Return's flashback cost, casting it from the graveyard.

Sneak Attack: '{R}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Sacrifice the creature at the beginning of the next end step.' The end-step sacrifice places the cheated creature into the graveyard. Dread Return: 'Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Chainer, Dementia Master: '{B}{B}{B}, Pay 3 life: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.' Either reanimation effect returns that same creature permanently, so one creature is deployed first from hand and again from the graveyard.

Worldly Tutor: 'Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, then shuffle and put the card on top.' Gamekeeper: 'When this creature dies, you may exile it. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield.' The creature Worldly Tutor places on top is the first card Gamekeeper reveals, so Gamekeeper's death deploys the chosen creature onto the battlefield.
requires: Gamekeeper dies after Worldly Tutor resolves

interaction_chains.mechanism: Worldly Tutor: 'Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, then shuffle and put the card on top.' Fa'adiyah Seer: '{T}: Draw a card and reveal it. If it isn't a land card, discard it.' The creature placed on top is drawn by Fa'adiyah Seer and, being a nonland card, discarded into the graveyard, converting a top-of-library tutor into graveyard placement.
requires: Worldly Tutor resolves before Fa'adiyah Seer's activation

interaction_chains.mechanism: Symbiotic Beast: 'When this creature dies, create four 1/1 green Insect creature tokens.' Dread Return: 'Flashback—Sacrifice three creatures.' The four Insect tokens Symbiotic Beast leaves behind are creatures that can be sacrificed to pay Dread Return's flashback cost.

Mesa Enchantress: 'Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you may draw a card.' Casting any enchantment or Aura (for example Wild Growth, Squirrel Nest, Griffin Guide, Pacifism, Sylvan Library) triggers the draw, so each enchantment cast replaces itself with a card.

Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.' Sylvan Library: 'At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw two additional cards' supplies the second (and third) draw of the turn. Mesa Enchantress's 'you may draw a card' on an enchantment cast is an alternative second-draw source. These are non-blue enablers of Jolrael's trigger.
requires: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse on the battlefield

interaction_chains.mechanism: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, for each Aura and Equipment attached to Valduk, create a 3/1 red Elemental creature token with trample and haste.' Undying Rage ('Enchant creature / Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and can't block') is a red Aura, so Valduk plus one red Aura makes the tokens in a single colour; Griffin Guide, Improvised Armor and Sun Clasp are white Aura alternatives.
requires: Valduk on the battlefield with at least one Aura or Equipment attached

interaction_chains.mechanism: Auramancer: 'When this creature enters, you may return target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.' Sevinne's Reclamation: 'Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield' with flashback. Both are white, so an Aura that dies is rebuyable in a single colour; Tiana, Ship's Caretaker ('Whenever an Aura or Equipment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may return that card to its owner's hand') is a red-white alternative that automates the return.

Zur the Enchanter: 'Whenever Zur attacks, you may search your library for an enchantment card with mana value 3 or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.' Each attack puts a mana-value-three-or-less enchantment directly onto the battlefield without casting it, so cast-triggered effects such as Mesa Enchantress do not trigger from it.
requires: Zur the Enchanter on the battlefield and attacking

interaction_chains.mechanism: Deadapult: '{R}, Sacrifice a Zombie: This enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.' Festering Goblin's type line is 'Creature — Zombie Goblin' and Undead Gladiator's is 'Creature — Zombie Barbarian', so both are legal Deadapult sacrifices with no type-changer needed. Zombie Infestation: 'Discard two cards: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.' supplies further Zombie tokens to sacrifice. Festering Goblin also reads 'When this creature dies, target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.', so sacrificing it to Deadapult additionally triggers that death effect.

Circular Logic: 'Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1} for each card in your graveyard.' Frantic Search: 'Draw two cards, then discard two cards.', Fact or Fiction: 'Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.', and Deep Analysis: 'Flashback' (which exiles it after a graveyard cast) each add cards to your graveyard, increasing the {1}-per-card tax Circular Logic imposes.

Undead Gladiator: '{1}{B}, Discard a card: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only during your upkeep.' is a discard outlet that recurs itself each upkeep. Dark Withering: 'Madness {B}' and Ichor Slick: 'Madness {3}{B}' — discarding either to Undead Gladiator's ability triggers madness, letting it be cast from exile for its madness cost.
requires: Undead Gladiator in the graveyard to reactivate the loop

interaction_chains.mechanism: Oversold Cemetery: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.' Entomb: 'Search your library for a card, put that card into your graveyard' and the discard outlets Frantic Search ('discard two cards') and Zombie Infestation ('Discard two cards:') put creature cards into the graveyard to reach the four-creature threshold and to supply return targets.
requires: four or more creature cards in your graveyard

interaction_chains.mechanism: Street Wraith: 'Cycling—Pay 2 life.' places Street Wraith, a creature card, into the graveyard for no mana while drawing. Dread Return: 'Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.' can then reanimate it or another binned creature, and Necrosavant: 'Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield' self-recurs from the same filled graveyard.
